'''Event Store''' ---- The '''Event Store''' was a place where you bought event items with {{Tickets|}}. To get {{Tickets|}}, you need to complete waves in the respective event maps, like [[Village of Despair]]. In [[Village of Despair]], each wave gave {{Tickets|10-50}} (prior to the 1st of January 2020, each wave gave {{Tickets|10}} and triumphing would give {{Tickets|600}}). In [[Eggy Island]], easy mode gave {{Tickets|10-25}} per wave whereas hard mode gave {{Tickets|25-50}} per wave. The '''Event Store''' has not been used since the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. It has since been replaced with the [[Passes]] (such as the [[Duck Hunt Event#Hunting Season Pass|Hunting Season Pass]]). ---- {{Tickets|}} could have been used to purchase certain items in the '''Event Store'''. This was located in the ''[[Rewards]]'' tab while the player was in the lobby. {{Tickets|}} do not carry over from past events. The total amount of {{Tickets|}} to complete the entire '''Event Store''' was about {{Tickets|20,500}}. ---- [[Christmas 2019 Event]] 24 December 2019 – 26 January 2020 {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; text-align:center; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:Gift_of_Joy.png|175px]] |[[File:Gift_of_Mystery.png|175px]] |[[File:Gift_of_Sharpness.png|175px]] |- !Item |Gift of Joy |Gift of Mystery |Gift of Sharpness |- !Content |[[Lazy Couch]] |4 [[Premium Crate]]s |[[Archer|Holiday Archer]] |- !Ticket Cost |{{Tickets|1,500}} |{{Tickets|2,000}} |{{Tickets|2,500}} |- !Robux Cost |{{Robux|150}} |{{Robux|200}} |{{Robux|250}} |} 1 January 2020 – 26 January 2020 {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; text-align:center; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:Fireworks.png|175px]] |[[File:Party_Skins.png|175px]] |- !Item |Firework |Party Skins |- !Content |[[Firework|Firework Emote]] |3 [[Party Crate]]s |- !Ticket Cost |{{Tickets|1,500}} |{{Tickets|3,000}} |- !Robux Cost |{{Robux|150}} |{{Robux|225}} |} ---- [[Spring 2020 Event]] 6 April 2020 – 26 May 2020 {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:100px; text-align:center; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:Bunny Crate.png|175px]] |- !Item |Bunny Crate |- !Content |1 [[Bunny Crate]] |- !Ticket Cost |{{Tickets|1,000}} |- !Robux Cost |{{Robux|800}} (for all 10) |}
==Trivia== *The '''Event Store''' is likely based on ''R2DA's'' [[w:c:r2da:Event Store|Event Store]], down to the usage of a secondary currency called [[w:c:r2da:Tickets|Tickets]] to purchase items featured in the store. {{BrowseNavBox}} [[Category:Features]]
